_about: George Trumbull Ladd (1842-1921), raw IA OCR: Elements of Physiological Psychology (New York: Scribner, 1889 printing; copyright 1887), Philosophy of Mind, an essay in the metaphysics of psychology (Scribner, 1895) and Philosophy of Knowledge (Scribner, 1897). US public domain. Added in round cm from Internet Archive scans dated on their title pages or versos: Primer of Psychology (1895), A Theory of Reality (1899), Philosophy of Conduct (1902), The Philosophy of Religion (1905, 2 vols.), Knowledge, Life and Reality (1909), The Teacher's Practical Philosophy (1911), the four Kantian-question books What Can I Know? (1914), What Ought I to Do?, What Should I Believe? and What May I Hope? (1915), and The Secret of Personality (1918). Not taken: his scripture and church-polity books (theology, another lane's), his travel books on Japan, Korea and India, and his translations of Lotze (keyed by translator, another lane's). No uids minted.
